parts.t: Central Coquitlam is the established heart of the city, providing residents with walkable amenities, strong SkyTrain and bus connections, and a wide variety of housing options from character homes to newer condos. It's a smart, convenient choice for buyers who want to be close to everything Coquitlam has to offer.
